stage_2_story.text_en:
Every Saturday morning, Avi puts on his old work clothes, grabs his gloves, and heads out to the garden. It is his favorite part of the week. His wife Miriam always says he loves his garden more than the television.

This morning, Avi decided to build a new raised garden bed near the fence. He used his shovel to dig out the area and level the ground. Then he filled his wheelbarrow with fresh soil from the pile near the shed and spread it evenly inside the wooden frame.

Avi had bought a packet of cucumber seeds and a packet of lettuce seeds at the market yesterday. He made small rows in the soil with his fingers, dropped the seeds in carefully, and covered them gently. Then he took the watering can, filled it from the tap, and gave the new garden bed a good drink.

Near the kitchen window, Miriam keeps three clay pots with herbs — basil, mint, and parsley. Avi noticed the basil pot looked too small, so he found a bigger pot in the shed and carefully moved the plant into it. He added a handful of compost to give the basil extra nutrition.

After working for two hours, Avi used the rake to clean up the fallen leaves on the lawn. He put the leaves into the compost bin behind the shed. Then he washed his tools with the hose, took off his dirty gloves, and went inside for a cup of coffee. Miriam had already prepared breakfast. She smiled and said, "The garden is lucky to have you."
